# Event fixtures

- `INITIAL_PURCHASE`, `RENEWAL`, `CANCELLATION`, `UNCANCELLATION`, `BILLING_ISSUE`, `EXPIRATION` and `envelope-example` are **byte-for-byte copies** of the official samples at https://www.revenuecat.com/docs/integrations/webhooks/sample-events and .../event-types-and-fields (fetched 2026-08-29).
- `TEST.json` is **PROVISIONAL**: constructed from the documented field groups because RevenueCat publishes no official TEST sample. See `docs/payload-sources.md` and ticket T-004.
